claude_only.name: Which authoritative identifier designates the grantor, and in which master system is it resolved?
In what capacity does the grantor act — data subject, owner, personal representative, guardian, or delegate?
What evidence documents the representative's authority, and when was it last verified?
What happens to an active grant if the authority basis lapses or is later found invalid?
Is the grantee an individually named party, a party collection, or a bearer of a transferable ticket?
Which onward recipients or sub-processors are within the grant, and under which flow-down duties?
How is the grantee authenticated at read time, and at what assurance level?
May the grantee sub-delegate its read right, and what record must exist if it does?
How is the covered set designated: enumerated identifiers, category codes, or an evaluable selector expression?
Is the covered set resolved as a snapshot at activation or re-evaluated live at each read?
Which creation or observation window of the covered objects falls inside the grant?
What is the specificity floor below which a scope clause must be rejected as too broad to be meaningful?
Which data categories are covered, expressed in which governed vocabulary and version?
Does the scope include special-category or sensitive data that requires explicit consent or a separate instrument?
Which categories are explicitly excluded by carve-out, and how is the exclusion enforced at read time?
Which security labels or handling caveats travel with the covered data once disclosed?
What is the declared purpose, and which coded purpose terms express it?
Is a proposed use inside the declared purpose, or does it require a new grant?
How granular must purposes be when several are offered in one instrument?
How is a later narrowing or widening of the declared purpose detected and handled?
Which action terms are permitted and which are explicitly prohibited under this instrument?
Does a permitted read include caching, indexing, derivation or aggregation of the disclosed data?
Is one decision valid for a single read, a session, or a standing entitlement?
Which actions beyond read fall outside this mixin and must be modelled elsewhere?
When does the grant enter into force and when does it end — a fixed instant, a defined event, or never?
Which quantitative limits apply, such as reads per period, total count or data volume?
Which spatial or jurisdictional constraints restrict where the read may occur or where disclosed data may land?
What outcome applies when a constraint cannot be evaluated because an attribute is missing?
Which duties attach to the grantee, and is each a pre-condition, a continuing duty, or a post-termination survival?
What consequence applies if a duty is not discharged by its deadline?
What evidence is required before a duty is treated as discharged?
Which duties survive revocation or expiry of the grant, and for how long?
Which affirmative act constituted the indication, and was any pre-ticked box, silence or inactivity relied on?
Was the service or contract made conditional on consent that was not necessary to perform it?
Was explicit consent required, and by what mechanism was the heightened standard met?
Which validity elements are evidenced in the record and which are only asserted by the capturing system?
Through which channel and interface was the act captured, and what exact wording version was displayed?
Which language and which jurisdiction applied at the moment of capture?
What was the event time of the act as against the time the record was ingested?
Is the referenced notice version immutably retrievable for the life of the record?
Which record structure and schema version is used to demonstrate the act?
What proof binds the record to the grantor's act, and who can verify it independently?
Is the record tamper-evident, and how is its integrity re-checked over time?
What minimum record must survive after the covered data itself is deleted?
What must the receipt contain for the grantor to understand and act on what they agreed?
Through which channel is the receipt delivered, and how is it re-obtained later?
Can a third party verify the receipt without contacting the issuer, and how is its current status checked?
Is the receipt machine-readable enough to drive withdrawal in a system other than the issuer's?
What is the enumerated state set, and which transitions between states are legal?
Which state is authoritative when the record store and a previously issued token disagree?
Can an instrument be suspended without being terminated, and what does suspension permit?
How is a proposed or requested instrument distinguished from an accepted and active one?
Which timestamps are mandatory on every instrument and every consent event?
Is a time without an explicit offset ever acceptable, and what is the fallback if one is received?
How is a correction to a recorded time captured without rewriting history?
Which time governs a read that begins before expiry and completes after it?
Which changes may be applied in place and which require a new consent act?
How are versions identified, ordered, and linked to the version they supersede?
From which instant does a superseding version govern, and what governs reads already in flight?
Is there an interval after which the instrument must be refreshed or re-confirmed?
Who may issue a withdrawal or revocation, and through which channels must it be possible?
From which instant does termination take effect, and are prior reads thereby invalidated?
Which processing may lawfully continue after withdrawal, and on what stated basis?
What confirmation is returned to the grantor that the withdrawal took effect?
Which recipients must be notified of termination, and within what deadline?
What counts as acceptable proof that a recipient stopped reading and deleted its copies?
What is done when notification is impossible or would involve disproportionate effort?
How are irreversible derivatives such as trained models, aggregates and publications handled?
Which attributes must the requester supply before a decision can be evaluated at all?
Which decision values may be returned, and what must the enforcing party do for each?
What may be returned alongside the outcome — obligations, scope fingerprint, expiry — without disclosing contract content?
How long may a decision be cached and relied upon before re-evaluation?
Is the default outcome denial, and under which narrow, declared conditions may any fallback permit apply?
How is an unevaluable constraint distinguished from one that was evaluated and not satisfied?
What diagnostic detail may be returned to the requester without leaking contract content?
Which unevaluable outcomes must raise an operational alert rather than resolve to a silent denial?
Which combining strategy applies when one instrument permits and another prohibits the same read?
Does a narrower or later instrument automatically supersede a broader or earlier one?
How is a conflict between the instrument and an overriding legal duty recorded and surfaced?
Is the combining strategy declared on the instrument or fixed by the adopting Dimension?
Which system of record is authoritative for this instrument, and what is its identifier there?
How is the record canonicalised before it is hashed or signed?
Who is accountable for the correctness of each recorded assertion?
How are imported or migrated records distinguished from natively captured ones?
How long must the instrument and its consent evidence be retained after termination, and on what stated basis?
Which fields must be minimised or redacted while keeping the record capable of demonstrating the act?
Does an erasure request from the grantor extinguish the consent evidence itself?
What is deleted, what is anonymised, and what remains as a tombstone after the retention period?
Who may read the full instrument, and who may receive only a validity token?
Which named projection does each role receive, and what does each omit?
May a grantee learn the identity of other grantees or the existence of other grants over the same objects?
How is supervisory or regulator access authorised, bounded and logged?
To which external standard concept does each core element map, and at what fidelity?
Which mappings are lossy, and precisely what is lost in each direction?
Is a conformance claim asserted against any target standard, and what evidence supports it?
What is the fallback when a target standard has no equivalent concept for a required element?
Which law governs this instrument, and which supervisory authority is competent over it?
In this jurisdiction, is the correct instrument a consent, an authorization, or another form with different mandatory elements?
What is the age at which a person may grant for themselves in this jurisdiction, and how is a lower age handled?
Which cross-border transfer conditions attach to a read performed outside the originating jurisdiction?

grok_only.name: What is the canonical identifier of this access contract, in which scheme, and which mastering system assigned it?
Which information-model profile and schema version interpret the terms of this instrument?
Is this instance the master record, a FHIR copy identifier, or a receipt that only references the record?
Is this instrument an Offer, an Agreement already granted, a FHIR draft, or a mere Set of rules?
Does this grant authorise processing of personal data on a consent legal basis, or only usage of a non-personal asset?
If a requested read matches no provision, is the default permit, deny, or invalid-by-conflict?
Who is the grantor, and which ownership, parental-responsibility or delegation record authorises them to grant?
Which party or party collection is the grantee, and are members refined by attributes such as role or age?
Is the data subject a different person from the grantor, as with a parent granting over a child's record?
Which actor manages the instrument through its lifecycle and which actor evaluates reads against it?
Which action or actions does this grant permit, and is read implied by a broader use action?
Must any duty be fulfilled before the permission may be exercised?
Which actions are prohibited for this grantee, notably onward share, archive, or commercial use?
For which specific purpose may the grantee read, and is that purpose a primary service purpose or a secondary purpose such as marketing or research?
Is the legal basis consent, explicit consent for special-category data, contract performance, or a non-personal licence?
May the grantee further process for a compatible purpose without a new grant, and if not, what amendment process is required?
Which registry objects, collections or classes does this clause cover, and how is a reference interpreted (this instance, related, dependents, authored-by)?
Does the clause limit the timeframe of the data (for example only encounters after 2024) separately from the grant's validity window?
Must the permitted read leave the holder only in a named projection or redaction shape?
From when until when is this rule exercisable, in RFC 3339 with offset, and is that window different from the data-period?
In which jurisdictions or locations may the grantee store or process the read results, and which geographic restrictions apply?
Is there a maximum number of reads or a frequency cap, and how is current status counted?
May the grantee disclose the read results to any third party, and if so to whom and for which purpose?
What must the grantee do when the grant ends or is withdrawn, and by which deadline?
Has this duty been fulfilled, on what evidence, at what event time?
By what affirmative act, on which channel, and in which language was consent given, refused or withdrawn?
What is the RFC 3339 event time of the indication, and what is the distinct ingestion time of this record?
What artefact proves the act, and is it a hash of a UI snapshot, a cryptographic signature, or a verbal-consent attestation?
Did the acting party consent as self, as holder of parental responsibility, as guardian, or as a recorded delegate?
If the principal is a child, which Article 8 age threshold applies, and is this a counselling service that does not require parental consent?
Was the grantor decision verified, by whom, with whom, and at what time?
Which privacy notice version was in force at indication time, and did it identify the controller, purposes, recipients, retention, transfers and withdrawal right?
Was consent separate from contract terms, unbundled by purpose, and free of a clear power imbalance?
Is there a withdrawal path that is as easy as the give-path, and was the principal told about it before indicating?
Where is the integrity-controlled consent record kept, and what proof binds it to the indication event?
Was a portable receipt issued, with which schema, to whom, at what time, on which channel?
Which fields of the record are copied into the receipt, and which are omitted for confidentiality?
Is the instrument in an exercisable status at the evaluation instant, and which vocabulary is being used?
Was activation by grantor signature, by assignee acceptance of an Offer, by UMA owner policy-setting, or by a verbal consent later recorded?
When was consent last reaffirmed or re-verified, and is reaffirmation required on notice change?
If the grant is not live, what kind of termination occurred, at what effective time, issued by whom?
Does this termination require erasure or return of copies, or does another legal basis keep the data?
If this instrument was superseded or amended, which instrument is now authoritative, and was the change agreed or unilateral?
If the grantor has died, lost capacity, or the organisation has merged, is there a jurisdictional rule that continues, freezes or voids the grant?
At evaluation instant T, does a live instrument permit this requester to perform this action on these objects for this purpose?
If denied, which fail-closed reason applied, and is the caller allowed to see that reason?
Which obligation identifiers remain binding even after a permit, such as no-onward-share or local-cache TTL?
Is there a current entitlement token, of which kind, expiring when, and is it unique to this requesting party and client?
Which parties currently hold copies or caches under this grant, and which have confirmed cutoff?
Were RPTs, refresh tokens and persisted-claims tokens revoked, at what time, and did refresh continue to mint access without re-assessment?
Which events have occurred on this instrument, in order, with event time versus recorded time?
Are all mandatory fields for the chosen profile present so demonstration is possible?
Has legal validity been assessed, with what result, and if uncertain what is missing (capacity, unbundling, notice, affirmative act)?
Which external standards is this instance projecting to, in which mode, under which profile URI?
Which documented conflicts affect this instance, for example legal-person grantor on a privacy-consent flavour?
Is any conformance to ISO 27560, GDPR, FHIR or ODRL actually evidenced, and by which artefact?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
